_comment: Ratchet, not permission. Every number here is what the repo measured after the editor/ split, so any regression fails the gate. Raising one is a deliberate, reviewable act; lower it whenever the measurement drops.
_topLargestFilesComment: 22184 -> 22330 for the tool-behaviour pass: retouch/type option panels that did not exist, gradient blend+opacity, pen curve handles, selection-aware move. The two largest new panels were split into options-bar-tools.tsx (-363) before raising this.
_coordinationFilesComment: view.tsx maxImports went 49 -> 50 when it was split: five subsystems (overlay previews, vector editing, filter overlays, text editing, transform drag) moved to editor/canvas/*, trading one extra import for ~1100 fewer lines. Lower it again as more leaves.
